newsitem.title: USA: Computer Products buys Elba Group.
newsitem.headline: Computer Products buys Elba Group.

text.p: Computer Products Inc, which makes electronic subsystems for power conversion, said it bought European company Elba Group, a privately-held maker of both AC/DC and DC/DC power conversion products, for $29 million cash.

Computer Products said the acquisition gives it a leg into the rapidly deregulating cable television business in Europe and access to Elba's established relationships with customers Telefon AB L.M. Ericsson, Eastman Kodak Co, and Siemens AG.
The company also said the deal adds low cost manufacturing capacity in the Czech Republic and should be accretive to Computer Products' earnings, though it did not say when.

Elba's revenues for the 12 trailing months ended June 30, 1997 were about $25 million, according to Computer Products. It has about 375 employees and operations in Germany, the Czech Republic and the Netherlands.
